text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking through the 
academy, a crowd had gathered in the 
hallway.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Whoaa... Lovely...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, there's definitely an 
indescribable aura about it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: She really is incredible...
choice_data_list: What are you doing?
What are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Miss Oguri is holding a press conference. 
Here, take a look.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Peeking into the room, Oguri Cap was 
answering an interview while dressed in 
her racing silks.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
She looks like she's ready to jump into a 
race right this second!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Whenever I put on my racing outfit, I 
naturally get into that mindset.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
We can really look forward to the main 
event, can't we!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'll give it my all to live up to 
those expectations.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Oguri-san in her racing outfit, how should 
I put it, really carries an air of 
dignity.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
A fighting spirit that burns quietly, 
alongside an undaunted confidence...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I think that's exactly what draws all the 
fans to Oguri-san, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
choice_data_list: What's the matter?
Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Compared to Oguri-san, I realized I still 
have a long way to go.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Even with Racewear, it feels more like 
the clothes are wearing me rather than the 
other way around, haha..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Mejiro Ryan lacks confidence in 
how she looks in her racing outfit, but...
choice_data_list: Shall we get started with training now?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? You're earlier than usual today. 
Not that I mind, of course.
choice_data_list:
Alright then, put on your race outfits and 
assemble!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Understood... Wait, what?! A Racewear?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: U-Um... I've changed clothes, but...
choice_data_list: Shall we try running a lap right away?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: What?! While wearing my racing outfit...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Even though I literally just said I 
couldn't pull off wearing it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan starts running shyly. And 
then—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
"It feels just like watching a real race! 
Ryan-senpai, do your best—!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
I'm always cheering for you! I just know 
you're gonna take 1st place in your next 
race, Senpai!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...
choice_data_list: We sure got a lot of cheers out there.

You got so much support from the crowd, 
didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yes, it was quite a surprise.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It makes sense for Oguri-san to get 
cheered on, but someone like me...
choice_data_list: Charm is something you build up over time.

Charm is something you build up over time, 
you know.

You're already someone people truly look 
up to.
You're already someone people look up to.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It makes sense for Oguri-san to get 
cheered on, but someone like me...
choice_data_list: Charm is something you build up over time.

Charm is something you build up over time, 
you know.

You're already someone people truly look 
up to.
You're already someone people look up to.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Charm builds up over time...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I see... Even if it's not on Oguri-san's 
level, I've still run my fair share of 
races...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It had piled up enough for people to start 
cheering for me...
choice_data_list:
A racing outfit is the culmination of 
daily hard work!

A racing outfit is the culmination of 
daily hard work!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, it's just like muscles!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's because daily efforts... and 
countless feelings overlap that it becomes 
so charming!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep running with all my might from 
here on out! I'll keep polishing my 
muscles and my racing outfit!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: All right! I'm going to run one more lap!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Realizing that steadily building up effort 
leads to charm, Mejiro Ryan began running 
with all her might.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Someone that people look up to, just 
like...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume E
text_block_list.text: Ryan-senpai! I watched your training!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume F
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, can we run together! I want 
to see your running up close, Senpai!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Wah-wah!? Everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume E
text_block_list.text:
"I've always admired seeing you in your 
racing silks, Senpai! Please run alongside 
me too!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah! If you're okay with me...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Trainer, I'm heading out now. 
This is no time for me to be moping 
around!
choice_data_list: Run your heart out!
Run your heart out!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'll go deliver a run worthy of this 
racing outfit!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of the junior who looked up 
to her in her racing silks, Mejiro Ryan 
began running with all her might.
